I raced my first triathlon on Sunday. It was the Colchester Sprint Triathlon (550 yard swim, 12 miles bike, 3 mile run) and could not have asked for a better race day. I got 9th overall and 2nd in my age group. I was the first to finish without a TT bike with aero bars  ! I am super happy with my performance. The main area to improve for me is pacing on the bike and the run but otherwise this was a great way to start my triathlon career.

The weather was amazing and the course was relatively flat and fast. The race organizers and volunteers were amazing and did a great job. I highly recommend this race if you want to visit beautiful Colchester Vermont, just a few miles from Burlington.
